keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Wimborne Town 1, Crawley Town 0. Yang Seung-Woo (Wimborne Town) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Ángel Díaz.
Joe Smith (Wimborne Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Wimborne Town 1, Crawley Town 0.
Substitution, Crawley Town. Oluwalopemiwa Aderoju replaces Danilo Orsi.
Substitution, Crawley Town. Nathan Tinsdale replaces Kai Jennings.
Substitution, Crawley Town. Josh Flint replaces Lewis Richards.
Second Half begins Wimborne Town 1, Crawley Town 0.
Sam Roberts (Wimborne Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wimborne Town. Max Bustamante replaces Joe Smith.
Cameron Munn (Wimborne Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Priestley Farquharson (Crawley Town).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Crawley Town. Ben Heneghan replaces Priestley Farquharson because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Max Bustamante (Wimborne Town).
Substitution, Wimborne Town. Jackson King replaces Max Bustamante because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nathan Tinsdale (Crawley Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crawley Town. Malcolm Ebiowei replaces Johnny Russell.
Goal! Wimborne Town 2, Crawley Town 0. Cameron Munn (Wimborne Town) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jackson King.
Charlie Barker (Crawley Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wimborne Town. Tyler Edmondson replaces Sam Roberts.
Substitution, Wimborne Town. Finley Toghill replaces Cameron Munn.
Substitution, Wimborne Town. Josh Carmichael replaces Owen Roundell-Price.
Jackson King (Wimborne Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ángel Díaz (Wimborne Town) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Wimborne Town 2, Crawley Town 0.
